# Core
* Changed: URLs generated by the `MediaUrlGenerator` now encode whitespaces as `%20` in version `v6.8.0.0`. This ensures valid URLs in media and Import/Export operations.
___
# Next Major Version Changes
## Breaking Change 1:
* Changed: Whitespace characters (`' '`) in Media URLs will now be URL-encoded as `%20`.

## Breaking Change 2:
* Changed: Method `encodeUrl` in `Core/Content/Media/Infrastructure/Path/MediaUrlGenerator.php` will now return the URL in its already encoded form.
